leadText: Fumihiko Tachiki (Japanese: 立木文彦 Tachiki Fumihiko) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Fumihiko Tachiki (Japanese: 立木文彦 Tachiki Fumihiko) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Tachiki was born on April 29, 1961 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. His first role in was that of Lt. Surge during . Later, in , he had gained two more important roles, portraying Professor Birch and Brock's Ludicolo. In his personal life, Tachiki formed a band with fellow voice actor Toshiyuki Morikawa, called "2HEARTS".
